entries.description: A single lesbian owns and works a 40-acre farm with a 1 acre garden and animals. Visitors, especially lesbians, are welcome, with camping space and a small nightly fee for stays over one night. Males are not forbidden if known to her or with women. Housing, cold running water, electricity, woods and farm land.
entries.raw_text: JAN F WALSH Two Towers, 201 S 132nd Ave, Shelby, MI 49455 (616)861-4939. I own a farm, live on it and work it somewhat. I raise animals and have a . 1 acre garden. I welcome visitors, especially lesbians as I am quite isolated, but I do not forbid males of any age access IF known to me or with wimmin. There is camping space galore. If the visit is over 1 night I ask for a $2 fee (I trade)/night per person to defray my costs (water, toilet paper, produce, etc). Drugs in moderation are fine. No proselytizing please. Extended visits (over 1 week) need to be decided in person. I welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, (males). I have/am: 1 lesbian, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing (cold running water only)/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land.
entries.notes: Listing heads with a person's name, so contact_name is Jan F Walsh and community_name is the name as printed. Type: Private/Individual Land because 'I own a farm, live on it' and 1 lesbian (two-woman rule). Land: street address 'Two Towers, 201 S 132nd Ave' treated as the land since she lives on the farm; I used 201 S 132nd Ave. Residents: 1 lesbian and 'live on it'. Acreage 40 (the '. 1 acre garden' is a garden, not total land). Accepted groups: 'girl and boy children, nonlesbian women' named; '(males)' in parentheses with no orientation, but in the 1982 directory males are not coded unless named - they are named as '(males)', and males of any age are not forbidden only if known to her or with wimmin; coded conservatively as not coded for males since conditional only. Focus: Recovery/substance-free NOT coded because 'Drugs in moderation are fine' - corrected: no focus.

entries.description: Co-op that owns DOE (Daughters of Earth) Farm in West Central Wisconsin: half wooded campground, half hayfield, orchard, garden, berries. Four womyn live there year round, more in summer. Part of the campground is chemical free. Welcomes new members/residents, girl children, boy children until age 2, and non-lesbian women; sliding scale fees.
entries.raw_text: WISCONSIN WOMYN'S LAND CO-OP Rt 2 Box 42, Norwalk, WI 54648 (608)269-5301. WWLC owns DOE (Daughters of Earth) Farm; half wooded campground, half hayfield, orchard, garden, berries, etc in West Central Wisconsin. The land is hilly, secluded, very beautiful. Four womyn live here year 'round, more in summer. Some of the campground chemical free space. Camping equipment available if needed. Sliding scale fees. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, boy children 'til age of 2, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 175 members almost all lesbians, 80 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type: Intentional Community/Cooperative: a co-op with 'Four womyn live here year 'round' and 175 members. Rural route address (Rt 2 Box 42) is the land; land location 'in West Central Wisconsin'. Residents 4: 'Four womyn live here year 'round' (175 members not all on land). Boy children coded with condition 'til age of 2. Non-lesbian women named. Focuses: Environmentalism/eco-friendly from 'chemical free space' (part of campground); Farming/self-sufficiency from farm, hayfield, orchard, garden, berries (weak, presented as what the land is).

entries.description: Two lesbians on 80 acres hope to build a community focused on interdependent care and healing; primitive camping open to womyn. Chemically free, no pets, no guns, no men. Welcomes girl and boy children by arrangement and differently abled women.
entries.raw_text: THE WEB c/o Lanning, Box 8742, Minneapolis, MN 55408 (612)983-2289. We are consciously creating a space in which to live our lesbian reality in harmony with the natural world. Primitive camping here is open to wimmin. We hope to build a community focused on interdependent care toward the healing and health of us all. Chemically free, no pets, no guns, no men. We welcome: girl and boy children by arrangement, differently abled. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 80 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/ electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on the land.
entries.notes: Type: Private/Individual Land: 2 lesbians (two-woman rule); 'We hope to build a community' but no active recruitment of members. PO box so land street/zip blank; no land location given. Residents 2: 'women living on the land' with 2 lesbians. Focuses: Lesbian separatism from 'no men' and 'live our lesbian reality'; Recovery/substance-free from 'Chemically free' (reads as drug/chemical rule); Disabled women from 'differently abled'; Environmentalism from 'in harmony with the natural world' plus 'Chemically free' (weak). Boy children 'by arrangement'. Primitive camping 'open to wimmin' not coded as non-lesbian women since 1982 directory.

entries.description: Vacation ranch for lesbians and gay men on holiday with tipi lodgings or campsites, food service, hot tub and sports facilities; some weeks womyn only. Two lesbians on 40 acres.
entries.raw_text: NORTH CROW VACATION RANCH RR 1, Box 62-A, Ronan, MT 59864 (406)676-5169. A new social alternative for lesbians and gay men on holiday. Tipi lodgings ($11/night) or campsite ($7/night). Some weeks are for womyn only. We provide food service ($11/night), hot tub, sports facilities, firewood and basic conveniences. Close by: swimming, boating, etc. Reservations preferred. We welcome: girl and boy children, gay males. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type: Retreat/Gathering Space: a vacation ranch defined by what it offers visitors. Rural route address is the land. Residents 2: 2 lesbians and 'women living and working on the land'. Gay men coded from 'gay males'.

entries.description: Four lesbians own 90 acres of woods, meadows and rocky bluffs with a creek and springs. Long-term plans include cabins for themselves and for visiting women, some farming, solar and appropriate technology, and a place that nurtures the female principle. Welcomes new members/residents.
entries.raw_text: REBECCA, SUSAN, ANNE & MAURINE 4026 Anderson SE, Albuquerque, NM 87108 (505)268-1863. The land is a combination of woods, meadows, and rocky bluffs. We have a creek and springs. Long-term plans include: cabins for our personal use, additional cabins and camping sites for use by visiting women (by pre-arrangement only), and some farming. Emphasis on solar and appropriate technology and on developing a place that nurtures the female principle. We welcome: new members/resident. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 90 acres, camping space, woods.
entries.notes: Type: Intentional Community/Cooperative: four women, welcoming new members/residents; however, they do not yet live on the land (cabins are long-term plans) so could be Land Fund; kept as group holding 90 acres. Land city/zip not guessed: city address is in Albuquerque and the land's location isn't stated; state NM inferred from mailing. Residents 0: cabins 'for our personal use' are long-term plans. Focuses: Environmentalism from 'solar and appropriate technology'; Farming from 'some farming' as a plan.

entries.description: Collective with 167 acres of woods, meadows and grazing land two hours north of San Francisco, seeking 2 lesbian-feminists for a new group because the old group (save one) needs to sell. Not into drug abuse or S&M. Welcomes new members and loans.
entries.raw_text: YORKVILLE WOMEN'S LAND COLLECTIVE c/o Annie, 50 Balmy, San Francisco, CA 94110 (415)285-5145. YWLC seeking 2 lesbian-feminists for new group. Old group (save one) needs to sell. Lots of land 2 hours north of SF. Needs committment, money and respect. Into building living space, relationship, feminism. Not into drug abuse or S&M. Send name, address and phone for full details. Issues & money still negotiable. We welcome: new members, loans. We have/are: 6 lesbians, 167 acres, camping space, woods and meadows, farm land (grazing).
entries.notes: Type: Intentional Community/Cooperative: calls itself a collective with 6 lesbians. Residents blank: no statement that women live on the land (6 lesbians counted only). Land state CA inferred from '2 hours north of SF'. Recovery/substance-free from 'Not into drug abuse'.

entries.description: Privately woman-owned 500-acre land open to camping and events June-September; horses boarded, workers welcomed. Daily and weekly rates. Housing limited to workers; near the Russian River.
entries.raw_text: THE RANCH c/o Helen Wagner, 440 Holladay, San Francisco, CA 94110 (415)824-5352. Privately Woman owned land open to camping and events June-Sept. Horses boarded, workers welcomed. Daily and weekly rates and special event rates $5/day and up. We welcome: new members, girl children, boy children under 10, nonlesbian women, dogs, horses. We have/are: 500 acres, housing/permanent structures limited to workers, plumbing, outhouses, camping space, woods, farm land, cook out grills, creek on land, near Russian River, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type: Private/Individual Land: 'Privately Woman owned land'. Mailing address is a San Francisco street while the land is near the Russian River, so land street/city/zip blank; state CA inferred. Boy children under 10 (condition). Residents blank: 'women living and working on the land' but no count. 'new members' welcomed noted.

entries.land_location_as_stated: 3 hours north of SF and close to the ocean
entries.description: Womyn's community and retreat on redwood-covered slopes, meadows, waterfalls and pools, with nine structures including a communal kitchen, guesthouse and bath house, gardens and an orchard. Began as an older womyn's community; now womyn of diverse ages, races and backgrounds seeking permanent members, especially lesbians over 50. Visitors $5/night with exceptions for working class/older/third world women.
entries.raw_text: LAVENDER HILL 1085 Greenwood Rd, Elk, AC 95432. A thriving womyn's community and retreat located 3 hours north of SF and close to the ocean. 160 acres of redwood-covered slopes, open grassy meadows, waterfalls, and pools for reflection. Nine structures including a communal kitchen, guesthouse, and bath house, look out over surrounding valleys and hills. A vegetable and flower garden, an herb garden, and an orchard. We began as an older womyn's community. We are now womyn of diverse ages, races and backgrounds, looking for permanent members (especially lesbians over 50). Visitors $5/night (exceptions: working class/older/third world women). We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women (possibly). We have/are: 8 lesbians, 60 acres, 10 housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity with generator, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: State typo: 'Elk, AC 95432' stored as CA; raw_text keeps AC. Type: calls itself 'A thriving womyn's community and retreat'; community named first so Intentional Community/Cooperative. Acreage: two figures, 160 acres in text and 60 acres in list; smaller (60) stored. Residents 8: '8 lesbians' with 'women living and working on the land'. Non-lesbian women '(possibly)'. Focuses: Older women from 'began as an older womyn's community' and 'especially lesbians over 50'; Working-class women and Women of color weakly from visitor-fee exceptions ('working class/older/third world women'); diverse races is inclusiveness.
